mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) combined with fluphenazine (antipsychotic) increases risk of hypertensive crisis, excessive CNS depression, and neuroleptic malignant syndrome due to monoamine accumulation and additive dopaminergic/adrenergic effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if combination necessary, use lowest doses with careful monitoring of blood pressure, temperature, and neurological status in controlled settings.
